test_title: RRB Group D 2025-26: General Intelligence & Reasoning - Live Test
subject: reasoning
question: Five boxes, A, B, C, D and E are kept in a vertical arrangement. Only one box is kept below box C. There are two boxes kept between boxes D and C. Box E is kept at the second place from the top. Only two boxes are kept above box A. Which box is kept at the bottom?
